title: Flow Procedural Text Missing in All Lods
description: Text labels are not visible at any LOD tier in the procedural flow editor canvas.
summary: Fixed procedural play hover crash (Maximum update depth): setHover/setPreselect/setEvalOutputs no longer bump platform.generation; Tree section sync skips identical maps; CallbackTreePanelDefinition caches by content fingerprint; SidePanel memoizes resolved tree config. Fixed passive wheel preventDefault on FlowCanvas via native non-passive listener. Preview widget now formats geometry/brep dictionary keys instead of em dash.
